items.caption: In this oracle-script style redraw, a branching form is above a rounded, looped form. This vertical arrangement is one reported layout of 好; the redraw alone does not establish the components’ identity or original motivation.
items.alt: Black glyph redraw with a branching form above a rounded, looped form.
items.selection_reason: The vertical arrangement helps contrast with side-by-side reported forms of 好 without assigning component identities from shape alone.
items.period: Shang oracle-script style; modern redraw, not a dated artifact specimen

limitations.text: 好’s original motivation remains unresolved. Proposals include mother–child affection, a woman’s beauty, and affection between a man and a woman; cited early uses do not directly attest the mother–child interpretation.
This is a modern redraw labeled by script tradition, not a photograph of a dated inscription. Its label does not establish a specimen date or a chronological sequence between forms.
